method: Unchanged v68 four-search best-training-score monoalphabetic decoder. Render every symbol not present in fitting text as ?. Never infer unseen assignments from test material; uncertainty at original token level retained as [UNKNOWN]. EVA letters are not assumed phonemes.
controls: Fresh same-work positions in60-80% interval, offsets1500/3000/4500; disjoint from v68. First400-word pool; withhold least frequent letter with >=3 occurrences, lexical ties; take first100 words not containing it. Next600words: first20-word consecutive window containing withheld letter. Fixed random substitution. Freeze keys before test. Require3/3 perlanguage: resolved accuracy>=.90,coverage>=.80,all withheld-symbol occurrences masked,zero masking of seen symbols. This is abstention-aware recovery, not complete decryption.
manuscript: Only qualifying languages. H training v65 folios; freeze v67 top20 anomaly-word sites plus previous/next P line within same page. Fit all readable complete H lines in those windows; exclude lines with uncertain tokens from fitting, preserve in output. Fit one key perlanguage, no retuning to F. Heldout H top20 rare(count<=2 in training),length>=4 types ranked by frozenv65 surprise, then same context window. Source-line joins become spaces in fitting objective, not inferred clauses.
comparison: One matched within-word letter-shuffle arm with same search effort, training and test shuffled deterministically. This is a diagnostic, not a calibrated significance test. Dictionary fraction uses language-model training vocabulary; model score and word matches are not semantic coherence. Show full decoded windows and every failed language/control.
limits: Retrospective split, no independent named-plant anchors, no semantic validation or syllabic/rebus search. H/F are readings of one manuscript. This stage tests a narrow fixed alphabet reading with context.
